How to Apply?
How to Apply?
Explore and choose your programme
Browse programme
Select proposed faculty/school/department/interdisciplinary research area based on your area of interest
Search for potential supervisor (optional)
Check fee and explore scholarship and financial support
Check application details
Check admission requirement
Check application period
Contact potential supervisor (optional)
Browse FAQ
Prepare the application
Prepare supporting documents
Take required test(s), if any
Identify two academic referees and ask for their consent
Apply online
Create an account in the Online Application System.
Refer to the Operational Guide for the step-by-step procedures.
Fill in the online application form and upload supporting documents
Pay for application fee and submit the on-line application
If some of the required supporting documents are not available at the time of submission,
upload the documents to the Online Application System once the document is available
Track your application
Check your application and referees’ report submission status via the Online Application System
Look out for email correspondence from HKU
Application result announcement
An email will be sent to you once there is an update to your application status
Applicants can also check the application result via the Online Application System
Accept your offer
Accept offer via the Online Application System
Submit required documents for conditional offer
For non-local student, check student visa requirement and start the application process if needed
Start planning for arrival such as accommodation, bank service, etc.
